title: Pistachio Pastry Delight
description: A delightful dessert combining the crunch of pistachios with the flakiness of homemade pastry.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a separate bowl, whisk together pistachio meal, granulated sugar, and salt.
Add cold unsalted butter and mix until crumbly.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs.
Add the egg mixture to the pistachio mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread the pistachio mixture evenly over the dough.
Sprinkle the chopped pistachios over the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow to cool completely before serving.
